svg.title: Geek Mind — One Agent Runtime, Multiple Embodiments
svg.desc: A four-stage closed loop: perception converts vision, sound, state, location and LiDAR into a Natural Language Data Bus; a single or dual Cortex LLM reasons and selects tools; local or cloud MCP servers invoke tools; robot execution maps actions to hardware and returns feedback to perception, state and memory. The right column preserves the Unitree Go2 mobile embodiment and ARX X5 manipulation embodiment with their existing hardware photographs.

g.text: Geek Mind — One Agent Runtime, Multiple Embodiments
From perception to action, with tools and feedback
Vision: You see Alex, a human. He looks happy and is pointing to a chair.
Sound: You just heard: “Bits, run to the chair.”
Handle tool invocation and return structured results
Map high-level actions to robot-specific controllers
Execute on real robot (e.g., Go2 / ARX X5)
Perceive → Reason (LLM) → Call Tools → Execute on Robot → Feedback (Closed Loop)
GEEK MIND · UNIVERSAL EMBODIMENT AGENT RUNTIME
